Numerology Table.purpose: Overview of 24 numerology numbers and how each is calculated

rows.name: Mulank
rows.formula: Birth Day → reduce to 1–9. Example: 25 → 2+5 = 7

rows.name: Bhagyank
rows.formula: Add all digits of complete DOB → reduce

rows.name: Birth Day Number
rows.formula: Actual birth date, e.g. 25 → 25/7

rows.name: Compound Number
rows.formula: Unreduced number before reduction, e.g. 16/7 or 25/7

rows.name: Name Number
rows.formula: Add numerical values of all letters of the name → reduce

rows.name: Soul Urge Number
rows.formula: Add values of vowels in the name → reduce

rows.name: Personality Number
rows.formula: Add values of consonants in the name → reduce

rows.name: Expression Number
rows.formula: Add values of all letters → reduce

rows.name: Maturity Number
rows.formula: Life Path + Expression Number → reduce

rows.name: Attitude Number
rows.formula: Birth Day + Birth Month → reduce

rows.name: Personal Year
rows.formula: Birth Day + Birth Month + Current Year → reduce

rows.name: Personal Month
rows.formula: Personal Year + Current Month → reduce

rows.name: Personal Day
rows.formula: Personal Month + Calendar Day → reduce

rows.name: Universal Year
rows.formula: Add digits of current year → reduce

rows.name: Universal Month
rows.formula: Universal Year + Current Month → reduce

rows.name: Universal Day
rows.formula: Universal Month + Calendar Day → reduce

rows.name: Karmic Debt Number
rows.formula: Look for 13, 14, 16 or 19 before reduction

rows.name: Master Number
rows.formula: 11, 22, 33 are generally retained

rows.name: Life Lesson Number
rows.formula: Identify numbers missing from the name's numerical values

rows.name: Balance Number
rows.formula: Based on initial letters of the name

rows.name: Hidden Passion Number
rows.formula: Number appearing most frequently in the name calculation

rows.name: Challenge Numbers
rows.formula: Calculated from birth day, month and year

rows.name: Pinnacle Numbers
rows.formula: Calculated from combinations of birth day, month and year

rows.name: Lucky Number
rows.formula: Usually derived from Mulank, Bhagyank and/or Name Number

core_numbers.title: Pinnacle Number
core_numbers.based_on:
1st = Sum (Month &  Day of Birth)
2nd=Sum ( Day & Year of Birth)
3rd= Sum ( 1st  & 2nd)
4th = Sum ( Month & Year)
core_numbers.describes:
1. Is an enhancement of Life Path Number
2.Shows Mid Term Trend
3. Show long term trend
core_numbers.example:
Date of birth
23 - 03-1982

Life Path Number = 5+3+2=10=1

1st =  Sum ( (0+3)+(2+3))=8
2nd = Sum ((2+3)+(1+9+8+2))= (5+20)= ((5+(2+0))=7
3rd= Sum (8+7)=15= 1+5= 6
4th= Sum ((03)+(1982) = ((0+3)+(1+9+8+2)=3+20=2+2+0=4

Pinnacle of 8 for 1st = Upto 35 (36-life Path Number)
Pinnacle of 7 for 2nd= 35 to 43 (Pinnacle 1+9)
Pinnacle of 6 for 3rd = 43 to 52 (Pinnacle 2+9)
Pinnacle of 4 for 4th= Above 52 (Pinnacle 3+)

Pinnacle Number for 2026 = 2026 - 1982 = 44 Years ___ 43-52 Years - Pinnacle Number = 8

core_numbers.title:
Challenge Number
LifeCycle Challenge= 3rd Challenge

2nd Challenge = |Day- Year|

core_numbers.describes:
1 Outstanding Challenges : Occur repeatedly in your life and enable you to master it

2.Mixed Challenge:Consists of Variety of different numbers brining the development that arises from working with multiple energies

3. Cipher Challenge is Zero Challenge

Day = 15= 6
Month = 08=8
Year = 1992=1+9+9+2=21= 3
Keep 11 or 22 as Master Numbers (do not reduce).

1st Challenge = |6-8| = 2

Challenge numbers follow the same age ranges as Pinnacles:

2nd Challenge: Next 9 years = 28+9 =37

4th Challenge: Remainder of life = Above 46
